hazards.name: Poor Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway can create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing mid-block.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked pedestrian crossings, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without designated protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located within the sidewalk, slightly narrowing the clear walking path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The wide roadway without mid-block crossings or narrowing features encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases pedestrian exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the width of the asphalt.

hazards.name: Multiple Curb Cuts
hazards.description: Frequent driveways for commercial properties on the right create numerous conflict points between pedestrians and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the commercial buildings.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and patching of the road surface can lead to tripping hazards or unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Multiple vehicles are parked perpendicularly across the paved walkway, completely blocking pedestrian passage.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image in front of the auto repair shop and adjacent building.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: A long fence and wall create a sterile environment with no 'eyes on the street', which can impact perceived social safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the property line

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crossings are visible along this stretch of wide roadway, increasing risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential tripping hazards and uneven surfaces.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or physical barrier separating the roadway from the pedestrian area, allowing vehicles to easily encroach on walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire street edge shown.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles, particularly the white truck on the right, block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which could create safety issues for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street near the intersection can block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Controlled Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, increasing risk for those attempting to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the street.

hazards.name: Wide, straight roadway
hazards.description: The wide and straight geometry of the road encourages higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending to the horizon

hazards.name: Multiple driveway curb cuts
hazards.description: Frequent vehicle access points across the sidewalk on the left side create conflict points between pedestrians and cars.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer between the sidewalk and the active travel lane.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming such as speed humps or narrowed lane markings to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point for the commercial area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: If roadway width permits, install a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Widen the narrow sidewalk on the right and add a planting strip or furniture zone to buffer pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk near the bus stop to provide a designated crossing point for transit users.

interventions.title: Street trees and furniture zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or bollards to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair sidewalk cracks to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and level concrete slabs and remove vegetation growth from joints to ensure a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Street trees and landscaping
interventions.description: Add trees and planters to the sidewalk area to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall street quality.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding a furniture zone with trees or planters would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, a marked crossing with appropriate signage could improve safety for those visiting the church.

interventions.title: Waste Management Infrastructure
interventions.description: Implement designated trash storage areas or enclosures to keep the sidewalk clear for pedestrian movement and maintain accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install street trees, planters, or bollards to create a physical and psychological barrier between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the four-lane roadway to two travel lanes with a center turn lane or median to reduce vehicle speeds and crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or into a new furniture zone to clear the walking path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add shorter, more frequent light poles to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Install Raised Curb and Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a continuous raised curb and a clearly defined sidewalk to physically separate pedestrians from moving and parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Delineation
interventions.description: Implement clear parking regulations and use bollards or planters to prevent vehicles from parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience through shade.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk at the intersection to physically slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility in this school zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk remains clear of obstructions like trash bins and repair any surface irregularities.

interventions.title: Signage Consolidation
interventions.description: Relocate the signpost to the edge of the sidewalk to ensure a clear, unobstructed walking path.
